offers_products.reason: Manufactures pumps, valves, connectors, brake pads, energy absorption and aerospace components across Flow, Motion, and Connect & Control segments.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is mainly engineered components; aftermarket repair and lifecycle support are secondary to manufactured products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells components and pumps to industrial, automotive, aerospace and energy customers, not households directly.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are automakers, rail operators, chemical and oil and gas firms, defense contractors and industrial manufacturers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Mostly engineered component and pump sales, with some repeat OEM and aftermarket orders; not subscription or contract-based.

cyclical_demand.reason: Industrial, automotive, and energy capital and OEM demand falls in downturns, though aftermarket and aerospace partly cushion it.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sales are components such as brake pads, connectors, valves and pumps, bought frequently, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured pumps, valves, connectors and brake components, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large automakers, rail OEMs, aerospace and defense contractors, and major chemical and oil and gas firms.

asset_heavy.reason: Global manufacturing plants for pumps, valves, friction and connectors need ongoing capital investment, but not extreme intensity.

notes: Asset-heavy is a judgment call, since manufacturing is moderately capital-intensive.
